name: resvary
description: Open-source prepaid credits and usage billing for AI products
author: horn111

scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build --workspace=create-resvary && npm run build --workspace=@resvary/demo && npm run build --workspace=@resvary/console
scripts.build:core: npm run build --workspace=@resvary/sdk && npm run build --workspace=@resvary/sqlite && npm run build --workspace=@resvary/circle && npm run build --workspace=@resvary/postgres && npm run build --workspace=@resvary/worker
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:core && npm run build --workspace=create-resvary && tsc --noEmit --project apps/demo/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project apps/console/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run build:core && npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:release
scripts.test:starters: npm run build:core && npm run build --workspace=create-resvary && node scripts/test-starters.mjs
